commit.message:
ci(codeql): scan actions only (no JS/TS source present) (#7)

CodeQL was failing because these doc-only showcase repos have zero
JavaScript/TypeScript files yet, and the previous workflow required a
JS/TS build target. Switching matrix to language=actions:
- Still provides SAST coverage on GitHub Actions workflow security
- Will not fail on doc-only repos
- Can re-enable JS/TS scan later when source code lands
- All actions pinned to commit SHA per OpenSSF Scorecard best practice

Co-authored-by: Stephen P. Lutar Jr. <stephen@szlholdings.com>
